overview: A luxury pants brand website that exudes exclusivity and craftsmanship. Features curated collections (Atelier, Heritage, Comfort), full e-commerce functionality, and a premium visual identity with deep navy, ivory, and gold tones — positioning the brand as the world's finest comfort luxury pants.
features: Luxury homepage with brand storytelling and hero section
Three curated collections: Atelier, Heritage, and Comfort
Product detail pages with craftsmanship callouts and size selection
Shopping cart and multi-step checkout with Stripe payments
Login and sign-up with Internet Identity authentication
Account dashboard with order history and wishlist
About Us page with artisan spotlights and material sourcing story
Premium design: deep navy, ivory, and gold color palette with serif typography
